name: Blade Fatigue Life
description: Composite blade fatigue life under variable wind loading. Checks whether predicted fatigue cycles exceed the minimum required service life.

elements.name: Remaining Fatigue Life
elements.description: Number of load cycles before blade failure. Uncertain due to material variability and wind load spectrum.

uncertainty.source: Material testing and load spectrum analysis

elements.name: Minimum Required Fatigue Life
elements.description: IEC 61400-1 design lifetime requirement (20 years at rated operation)

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(N_fatigue) = N_fatigue if N_fatigue >= N_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The IEC 61400-1 design lifetime requirement guards the fatigue life uncertainty set; values below 2,000,000 cycles indicate premature blade failure risk.
